title: 2 a.m. buzzing and knocks in Florida home
summary: Peter Levenda tells of 2 a.m. buzzing and knocks in Florida home, about years after the Singapore encounter at Florida, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: years later then I'm in I'm at home. I'm in Florida now. And uh 2:00 in the morning, something like that.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about hidden history, says that years after an earlier strange encounter in Singapore, he was at home in Florida around 2 in the morning when he heard buzzing and knocking. He tells it alongside the experiences of Whitley Strieber, a writer known for describing visits from strange beings, as a sign that such contact can follow a person home.
